isolation.homes: Independent temporary HOME/AW/Agent/XDG roots and project/neutral directories per scope.
isolation.clientInstallation: Exact public npm versions; installation scripts disabled; temporary prefixes removed.

extraction.outputs: Checks, bounded stdout and per-command processManagement are copied from the redacted source report. Native stderr is omitted. No response body or result is invented.
extraction.paths: Original report placeholders <TEMP_ROOT>/<CLIENT_BIN>/<HOST_HOME> are retained. Entry digests identify only the recorded entry file; package integrity and lock digests remain separate.

qualificationBoundary.products: Only Gemini CLI 0.67.0 User ordinary Skills in Linux, macOS and Windows x64/arm64. Project, App and other versions or hosts are excluded.
qualificationBoundary.surface: Native extension installation, current-body discovery, refresh, removal and discovery from both project and neutral working directories from the AW projection candidate.
limitations: No prompts, model requests, ordinary new-session adoption or model-adoption qualification.
No Skill invocation controls, tool restriction, MCP, Hook, Agent or Instructions execution qualification.
User fixtures explicitly trust the isolated source and working directories. This trust does not qualify another directory or credentials.

Project Native fixtures manually insert the !* default-disable rule. Those passed Project cells are excluded and do not establish production project-only activation or remove nativeScopeIsolationUnverified.
Only the six passed User Native cells qualify. All six original reports and all twelve Gemini public AW cells remain unverified; no source report is changed.
Public AW adapter end-to-end acceptance requires a new real report and is separate from this record.
Process receipts support only the recorded lifecycle and discovery qualification, not other Provider, OS or profile capabilities.
No extrapolation to Project, App, another version, OS, architecture, component or feature.
